text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirming solo arrival at aquarium.
Commencing
operation—"change of
pace."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bourbon! You here by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My trainer had some business to
attend to,
so I was instructed to enjoy a
"change of pace" by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When I was young, I obtained data
suggesting
that visiting an aquarium is an
effective way to
relax and brighten one's
mood.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How about hanging out with me for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez was supposed to come too, but
she's still
stuck in a meeting at the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have seen data showing that socializing
with
multiple people can double the
mood-changing
effects. Let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Okay, first off, let's start with
the
aquarium's crown jewel—the dolphin
show!
Splaaaaash!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Oh! This dolphin's movements are...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, you feelin' okay? You've had
your head
in the clouds half the time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I recalled a memory about a certain
thing my
father once told me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"A dolphin's movements are matched
perfectly to
its surroundings. The driving
force of those fins
could be a hint to
improving your running."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's the kind of stuff you two
talked
about at aquariums? Talk about
quirky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But then again, I kinda get it. Prez is
always trying
to come up with all sorts of
quirky quips.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be like, "Let's go see the dolphin show," and she'll be all like, "I hope we get there before it finishes."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone enjoys things in their own way,
so it's all
good! That's how we have fun
around here!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That will become a precious
memory, as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have successfully elated my mood and
cleared
my mind. I will now return to
Trainer with my
report.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go back and see Prez too! Let's
book it
back to the academy! ♪

After gaining some insight during her
break,
Mihono Bourbon improves her
running skills!
